message.content:
Yes, you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta’s local authorities. In Atlanta, noise complaints are typically handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** or the **Department of Public Safety**. Here’s how you can do it: | Step | How to File | Contact Information | |------|-------------|---------------------| | 1 | **Online** | Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website and navigate to the “Noise Complaint” section. You’ll find a form that allows you to submit details such as location, time, and description of the noise.
URL: https://www.atlantaga.gov/ | | 2 | **Phone** | Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non-emergency line at **(404) 656-4000**. They can take your complaint over the phone and direct it to the appropriate unit. | | 3 | **In Person** | If you prefer, you can visit the nearest police precinct or the Department of Public Safety office to file a complaint in person. | | 4 | **Mail** | Send a written complaint to the City of Atlanta Police Department:
Address: 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30308 | ### What to Include in Your Complaint - **Date & Time** of the noise incident - **Location** (street address or intersection) - **Description** of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs) - **Duration** of the disturbance - **Any relevant evidence** (audio recordings, photos, or witness statements) ### Follow‑Up After filing, the police will investigate and may issue a warning or citation depending on the severity and frequency of the noise. If the problem persists, you can request a follow‑up inspection or escalation to the Department of Public Safety. If you’re unsure which agency to contact, the City of Atlanta’s website provides a quick lookup tool based on your address to determine the correct jurisdiction.
